{"type":"assistant","message":{"content":[{"text":"All 8 tests pass and the test file is restored to its original state.\n\n## Summary\n\nI upgraded `org.apache.shiro:shiro-core` from **1.13.0 → 2.0.1** and fixed the production code for the major-version API changes.\n\n**Manifest change** (`pom.xml`):\n- Bumped the managed `shiro-core` version to `2.0.1`.\n\n**Production code changes** — Shiro 2.0 reorganized packages and redesigned the crypto/hash APIs:\n\n1. **`AES.java`** (`symmetric/`):\n   - `org.apache.shiro.crypto.AesCipherService` → `org.apache.shiro.crypto.cipher.AesCipherService`\n   - `org.apache.shiro.util.ByteSource` → `org.apache.shiro.lang.util.ByteSource`\n   - `decrypt(...)` now returns a `ByteSourceBroker` instead of a `ByteSource`, so I retrieve the plaintext via `.getClonedBytes()`.\n\n2. **`SHA512.java`** (`hash/`):\n   - `org.apache.shiro.util.ByteSource` → `org.apache.shiro.lang.util.ByteSource`\n   - `DefaultHashService` lost its `setPrivateSalt` / `setGeneratePublicSalt` / `setHashIterations` setters and now defaults to `argon2` via an SPI (`HashProvider`/`SimpleHashProvider`).
